what: Medpace runs clinical trials for small and mid-sized biotechnology companies. Unlike larger contract research organisations it keeps all services in-house and assigns a single team to a programme from start to finish.
customers: Small and mid-sized biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device companies, mostly without their own trial infrastructure.
money: full-service clinical trial design, management and laboratory work
moat: A fully integrated model that avoids the handoffs larger rivals rely on, giving small biotechs a single accountable team, which has produced consistently faster trial delivery.
risks: Its customers are small biotechs, whose funding dries up when capital markets close
Trial cancellations reduce the backlog that converts into revenue
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 75%, exceptional for any company
Revenue grew about 20% last year and about 20% a year over three years
Cash of about $705 million against almost no debt funds large buybacks
watch: Net new business awards and the book-to-bill ratio.
